mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; doxycycline may have minor CYP450 effects, but the primary concern is additive anticholinergic effects and potential GI motility issues from doxycycline reducing drug absorption.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation); ensure adequate spacing of doses and monitor renal function; consider alternative antibiotics if anticholinergic side effects become problematic.
